scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0091; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: The play is good and I want to see the play are natural uses of play as a dramatic work.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently preserves play as نمایشنامه rather than the verb بازی کردن.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The noun sense is explicitly bounded and contrasted from the common verb sense.

distractorQuality.evidence: The key distractor بازی کردن directly checks sense discrimination without ambiguity.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The community-hall context supports discussing a play and seeing it tonight.

difficultyFit.evidence: The final want-to-see sentence is longer but remains controlled and familiar A1 language.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The target moves through meaning recognition, evaluation and intention.

transferQuality.evidence: The target shifts from evaluating the play to expressing an intention to see it.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, bounded sense and all tasks align on dramatic work.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the dramatic-work noun sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this stage.
resolvedFindings: The noun sense is kept distinct from the verb sense.
Character and learner-role rotation are maintained.
